items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: But Zutty's the one that got Mel Powell started and wanted Mel Powell to play with him at Nick's.

ctx.x: I don't think Mel Powell has said anything But Zutty's the one that got Mel Powell started and wanted Mel Powell to play with him at Nick's. And Nick didn't like the idea of a white boy playing with a black boy. And Zutty told him, said he can play the piano man. But Zutty had to get a black piano player. He wouldn't let Mel play with the outfit.
He let him play one night.
